The original MiniWireshark: a **"super noob-friendly" single-file packet sniffer** (2,726 lines).

- Automatic elevation, dependency install, driver install and network-card choice.
- Quiet discovery of devices on your own Wi-Fi or LAN (ARP, mDNS, SSDP).
- Self-heals when the capture socket dies.
- A paced plain-English feed, so a beginner can keep up.

> The file carries no version number, and this version was written before the repository's git history began. The tag points at the earliest commit in the repository, and the file is attached as it was kept.

---
**Run it:** download the `.py` file and run `python <file>` (Python 3.8+ with Tk). Check the download against the attached `.sha256` file.
Archived release, kept for reference. The current version is on the [latest release](https://github.com/darkckillerc4/MiniWireshark/releases/latest).
